evidence.title: How a Georgia Tech team used the open Olmo stack to trace social reasoning

summary: A team at Georgia Tech used the open-source Olmo model stack to analyze how large language models perform social reasoning, mapping the decision pathways within the systems. The findings provide a new approach for interpreting model behavior and addressing bias in AI applications.
title: Georgia Tech Researchers Leverage Open Olmo Stack to Trace Social Reasoning in AI Models
